reviews.comment: This class was very interesting and Professor Breyer did an amazing job in her lectures and giving us a lot of information to prepare for the exams! There were a few group projects, but she gives a lot of time to prepare and connect with our group members. There are mini pop quizzes after lectures as well.
If you want a easy KICD, take this class online. The class is super easy. The professor is very communicative and gave us frequent reminders to submit our work. She cares about her student's success.

She is a very passionate and enjoyable professor. You will be reading and writing a good amount in this class but the material is interesting and she offers a lot of support for longer writing assignments. Be prepared to put in effort but also don't be afraid to ask for help.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super easy class, definitely recommend taking online. Professor is very communicative.

Amazing professor and actually taught the material instead of just reading off the slides. Super nice and gives out a lot of extra credit. Tests aren't bad, just have to memorize the slides. Amazing class and professor.

I loved having Dr. Breyer! Her classes were always fun and she tried to make them interactive. She has random participation assignments which are added to your grade as extra credit at the end of the semester! The final was optional if you were content with your grade also! If you have the opportunity to take her class, do it!

A very EZ class. She's a great lecturer, very lenient for you to make stuff up, and just really nice. In the lecture before the exam, she presents everything that will be asked on the exam, which is also nice. Heavily recommend for people who are actually interested in geography and the bums that are only taking it for credit.

I took Professor Breyer for GEOG201 for Fall 2025. She basically made me love Geography. She makes sure to put 100% effort in every lecture. It was a free textbook class, and we had exam review slides posted, but you still needed to show up for participation points.
Straightforward grading and easy exams. I really enjoyed her class despite having it in the morning. I would recommend her class to anyone
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Never paid attention in lecture was just there for PollEv points. Exams were 30% of grade so don't stress over those. Try and make a few friends so you aren't cooked for the 2 group projects.

Dr. Byeyer kept students well-informed and updated on assignments and their due dates throughout this simple online course. Quizzes and tests are straightforward. Only minor annoyance is the Persuall platform assignments and group projects. Tons of opportunities for extra credit that can get you beyond a 100. Has inspired me to minor in Geography.
Take this class for an easy A. Most important parts: No final, unproctored exams, and generous grading. Overall, super organized online class, only annoying part are the Perusuall Assignments.

For online class all 3 exams are online, non-proctored, and open note. Other assignments like the quizzes, 2 group projects, and perusal assignments are hard at all, but they can be a bit time consuming. Class is basically just busy work. Def take geog201 online if u can, its the easiest thing ever.

Rly easy class and great prof! Its a lot of busy work but isnt hard, there'll be like 6 "quizzes" due on wednesday but 5 of them are literally 1 question and one is 10. 2 group project also arent bad, its 2 reports but less than 2k words split between 4 ppl. Shes great at answering any questions you have. Only annoying thing are perusal assignments
She is very good at explaining the material during lectures, but even if you don't pay attention, you could just look at the slides like an hour before the exam and probably still get an A.
Great teacher, very clear syllabus and assignments, if you studied 2 hours the day before the exam with no previous knowledge you could easily get an A. Just don't let to many absences rack up.

Dr. Breyer is a decent prof, she is definitely very knowledgeable on the content but basically just goes over slides and has attendance quizzes every class. For the tests all you have to study is the review slides the day before. Group projects are ok, perusals suck but easy. I also swear she has like 2 outfits and just alternates every class lol.

Wonderful class, all material we went over was available online. Did have Poll Everywhere for attendance, and she claimed that she would sometimes say things not on the slides that were on the test (although I think that was a trick to increase attendance). Group projects can be done in an hour or two, light studying for the tests, easiest A ever.

She is a great professor and makes the class very manageable. There are group essay projects worth a large percent of your grade but aside from that the class is easy and self paced. All the quizzes and tests are open note. I highly encourage this course and prof. It was an interesting course too and gave me a lot of new perspectives.

Dr. Breyer always gave great lectures featuring live 'check for understanding' questions. These also count as your attendance, so be sure to show up. There's a quiz over every unit and 2 group research projects later in the semester, but those aren't hard as long as you pay attention. She even walks you through what you need to know for the exams.

She is a good professor, but reads straight off the PowerPoint which makes lecture basically pointless to go to EXCEPT for the lecture quiz (which is the “attendance”). It's quite boring, and her exams are not bad but you might want to study more than a day before. there are group projects & several perusall assignments. she is easy to reach too.

Has a series of lecture videos per week, with either a video you have to watch or a small project. Make sure to follow the exact rules presented in the projects because she grades PURELY on the rubric rather than understanding. Cares about the course. Notes are available during the tests. Easy A.

Super easy class as long as you show up, attendance is mandatory every day, but everything else is very manageable. Grading is super lenient, and even if you score a little low on exams, the projects and other assignments balance it out. Definitely an easy A if you stay consistent.

One of my heaviest homework reading classes in my college carreer. She is a tough grader and does not give clear outline on assignments and what exactly(specifically she wants). Also unfortunately not very kind and condesending when something isnt answered correctly/passive aggressive. Tests are alright, group projects are a big part of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Holy perusall. Actually one of the most dense classes I've ever taken, she does everything imaginable. Group project presentation, individual project presentation, papers, exams, homework (perusall), etc. She's not bad, she can be helpful but I fear she also feels inclined to control conversations. An okay class if you need the credit. Good luck.

This course is extremely organized. Due dates are clear. Her lectures are to the point and no longer than 30 mins each. Quizzes have unlimited attempts. Exams are unproctored. There's 1 extra cred question on each exam. Group projects are very simple. She's easy to communicate with and has prompt replies. Definitely recommend!

Took her class last semester. Quizzes (17.5%), exams (30%), Perusall (10%), written assignments (15%), and group projects (27.5%). Very helpful at office hours. Lectures can be boring. Easy class to knock out your ICD and social and behavioral science. Nothing is proctored, and quizzes have unlimited attempts. I wish I could take her again.

Easiest A of my life by far. Prof Breyer makes the class very easy to do at your own pace and makes every lecture engaging. She responds very fast to emails and clearly cares. Definitely take this class if you need the credit for it.

She's awesome. Her lectures were good & assignments deepened understanding. She made the class straightforward and examinations were also direct. Lectures were a bit long but taking notes & listening were more than enough. She's also very tech savvy & accessible outside of class if you need a make-up or simply have questions. I 100% recommend her.

Dr. Breyer has really informative lecture videos and is super nice. There are 3 exams with module quizzes that are due before the day of the exams giving you plenty of time to complete them plus 2 short group projects that you have the option of completing alone if you don't enjoy working with a group and occasional perusall or writing assignments

Easiest A of my life. Online, unproctored exams. A few podcasts and written assignments, but very light. The only thing to beware of are the 2 group projects because you get randomly paired up with people online, and my group was pretty useless, but that was my experience. The projects were graded super light anyway.

Dr. Breyer is one of my favorite professors. I took her for a online course and by far one of the easiest courses. She has it set up very organized. There is a lot of course work, but you can get it done well in advance before the exam, I was always ahead in her class. She allows open note exams and you can take the quizzes over until you get a 100

This is the easiest class I've taken so far and Dr. Breyer is great. There's lecture videos, not super long if you speed them up, and you can watch them at your own pace. Exams are online and not proctored, and no final. All the assignments are easy. There's two group projects, but they're not difficult or time consuming if you have a good group.

I took Dr. Breyers online class and it was amazing!! Her canvas is super straightforward and organized. There are few group projects that were super easy and her tests are open note. She is very communicative and is super quick to respond and help with questions. I would recommend this class to anyone!

I love this professor, I've had her twice and attendance is not mandatory but I recommend going and getting to know her. She's incredibly helpful in ArcGIS and the lab TA's are amazing. I personally thought the exams were hard and I did really bad on them, but even so I still got an A. Do your labs, go to GIS Day, and make a good final project.

Amazing professor. Lectures are straightforward and she is easily accessible. She does however give lengthy assignments but its really easy to score 100 as long as you follow the rubric. Easiest A ever highly recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took this class online and it's very easy as long as you do the work! You can choose doing the group projects individually, I did them by myself and got a 100 on both. Ended with an A+ in the class! Lectures are straightforward, she is accessible and very nice! 10/10 recommend!

Love Dr. Breyer! She made GIS super accessible and beginner friendly during this course. Attend and complete all labs, take notes over all the lecture slides (even if you miss lecture), and you'll have an easy A. Very passionate about geography and wants her students to succeed. TA's were also helpful and graded well which is a bonus.
Highly recommend for anyone needing the credit. :)

I took online. Very good professor. The assignments and lectures were all in your own time which was super nice. There is a lot of work, but it can get completed very fast. She grades very lenient, just try your best on assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Breyer is great for Geog201, exams are all open note, no final, one group project, snd all of the content on the exams is in the lectures and lecture slides are posted. Very straight forward! 100% recommend and would take again!!
Very straightforward class. All necessary information is provided in the slides. There are quizzes, exams, group projects, and individual assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Breyer did a great job of discussing policy that was interesting and teaching students how policy and science go hand in hand. The projects were easy and fun, but played a lot in your grade. Great elective.
Class is super easy if you use your resources its pretty much a free A with almost no effort.
JUST TAKE HER. One of the easiest classes you will have ever.

Took this class for the Social and Behavioral Sciences credit. Tests are straight from lectures/notes, quizzes are online, and two group projects that are fairly simple. Dr. Breyer has a good lecture style and is easily accessible.

This professor was amazing! We had many quizzes that were fast and not proctored. Lectures are helpful but she would do a review day before the exams and would tell us exactly what we needed to know for the tests (not open note). The two project instructions were very clear and not harshly graded. I definitely recommend this class for an easy A!
great!
Absolutely loved taking Human Geography with Dr. Breyer. Highly recommend this course for a UCC credit.

GEOS 430: Best professor by far! Incredible lecturer. You can tell she cares for her students and is extremely involved in the assignment/project process which is very helpful. It would be hard to not get an A in this class. She also gives out 2 free mental health days! TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class is an easy UCC but man it can be boring sometimes. Projects are fairly time consuming but don't seem to be graded too difficultly.

I adore Dr. Breyer! I really like her lecture style and she is so good at explaining the course material. The projects you get are a little time consuming, but not difficult. It is very easy to do well in this class if you take good notes and stay on top of your work!

TAKE THIS CLASS I loved Dr. Breyer. I took this class asynchronously, and I loved it. Her lectures do get very boring, but it is geography, so you can't do much about it. All I did for this course was I put all the slides into one pdf and cntrl f'd on the exam. I got an easy A in the class. The group projects are fun and the assignments are easy.

Took this class online and it was pretty easy. She gives out lots of quizzes however you have plenty of time to do them and you can keep redoing them until you get the grade you want. Tests weren't too bad and you can find lots of reviews online. Would definitely recommend taking this class.

From interesting lectures to an organized schedule, Dr. Breyer is great! Labs were fairly long, but ~1 week to finish and go to lab session! No surprises on exams, just a lot of info. One final project that was extensive, yet manageable and actually enjoyable. Go to office hours with any questions; she's happy to help and clearly answers questions.

I never watched any of the lectures and still ended up with a 97. Exams are online and open note which makes it almost impossible to do bad on them. Read over the slides right before the exam and you should at least get an A. Group projects are a bit annoying but not too hard to do, though this depends entirely on your group.
Be sure to take notes from lectures to do well on the exams!

Really nice and responsive teacher. Class is extremely easy, with open note/book tests, as well as tons of easy assignments. Two writing assignments (time consuming, but not graded harshly), and two group projects you can choose to do with or without a group. Overall easy A if you manage your time properly.

Amazing! take online tho, its open book, super organized, straight forward, easy to get a hold of, 2 group projects that are online. Just don't take it in person, also if you want an A you have to listen to the lectures. easy to do at your own pace. no final finishes early

This class is an easy A so long as you pay attention to the lectures and take notes. Online exams seldom have the answers online as her exams are pretty original, but as long as you know the basics of the course, you will be fine. She is an easy grader as well, even though there's two group projects, she gives good grades overall.

Breyer gives you all the resources to succeed in this class. Majority of your grade comes from written assignments, exams, and one group project. All quizzes are free 100s. Tests are lengthy, so just make sure you study her lectures. The project is only a few parts; the hardest aspect being a final report, but is easily manageable within your group

LOVED her. She is super easy to get in touch with, the TA graded super easy, and she is super passionate about this. All lectures are recorded with weekly quizzes (due right before exam). EASY A! Only hardish things is the group work but if you communicate well its super easy. TAKE this course!

I got over 100 in GEOG 201. I have not made many A's in my five semesters so far. There were so many people that had no clue what was going on and ended up making B's. She is very nice and outlines exactly what you need to know for the test.

I'm so glad I had the opportunity to be in Dr. Breyer's class again this semester. She is very passionate about what she teaches and the way she lectures is engaging. Exams are very easy if you put in the effort and study. Labs, however, can become time consuming but they are pretty easy to follow along with. I highly recommend Dr. Breyer!!!!

Her lectures are refreshingly concise, making clear exactly what you need to study for the exams. The bulk of the grade are the group projects, for which expectations are made abundantly clear through the rubric published ahead of time. With a decent group, these projects are quite easy and have large time windows to complete.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Breyer is an awesome GEOG 201 prof! Her voice is soothing and easy to listen to. She makes the material interesting and ties it in to everyday life. Quizzes came straight from her lecture slides, and so do tests. There are group projects that are easily doable as well. I highly recommend her!!!

A very good choice! She is very clear and concise during her lectures and she is extremely good at being very accurate in the way that she says things. Lectures are easy to follow and assignments aren't unbearable at all in my opinion.

AMAZING prof. Super sweet and super helpful. All her powerpoints get uploaded (at least with covid semester) and they are super detailed. Multiple group projects which arent that bad if you get good partners. I would have made an A if it werent for my partners in the projects.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is online and has not been updated post-covid. It's not that big of a deal, but I wish the class would've adapted a little. She'll talk about topics like pandemics and global supply chain issues in her lectures, but then not relate them to the world we are living in today. Just a little annoying. Other than that I have no complaints.
She is very nice and ready to help. Tests are open-book and the copies from past quizzes. Submit your work on time and just read the lecture slides afterwards. It's an Easy A!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Breyer is such a great professor, she definitely knows what she's talking about and her lectures are always interesting. Exams are open-note and unproctored, and many of the questions are repeated in the quizzes beforehand. Group projects can suck based on who is in your random group, but they're not difficult at all. Easy A if you try.

I would not take her again. She is passionate about her subject but her method of teaching is reading off of powerpoint slides. She never switches it up and it gets very boring. I had to stop attending class because I couldn't stay awake. WAY too many group projects. I felt like my grade depended on other people more than it should have.

As a non-major, I found this class to be incredibly insightful. Professor Breyer's lectures were never boring and she seems very passionate about the subject. She is also organized and has adapted well to online learning. Her grades don't always get posted timely, but the class itself is pretty easy so no complaints.
This is not the hardest class in the world. A few group projects and a few individual essay assignments. Tests are really hard for whatever reason. Quizzes are an easy 100%.

This was Dr. Breyer's first year at A&M and I hope it's not her last! THIS TEACHER ROCKS. 2 tests and one final, tons of extra credit, and a few group projects. I thought this class would be horribly boring but I actually enjoyed going (even though you don't need to at all) Uploads her lecture slides which are what the tests are over. She's amazing

One of the nicest professor's I have had in my college experience. She took a somewhat difficult course and made it very straight-forward. She lets you know what is expected from you in the beginning and is also understanding of personal situations. Labs can be time consuming but that is expected. Anyone would be lucky to take her.

She's great, do your HW and you'll pass. The labs are semi-time consuming (3ish hours each) and she posts all of her PPs. I feel that I really have a good understanding of the material. Gives extra credit too.

Honestly the breath of fresh air I needed. Her material is straightforward and she tells you exactly what you need to know for her exams. I was too sick for a chunk of the semester to come to class and still passed just by studying her slides on Quizlet. If you need an easy A, a nice prof, or just a really interesting class, Betsy's the real one.

Breyer has been a delight! This is her first year teaching here and she's been all but caring and kind. Posts slides online, has reviews over exactly what's on the exams, and all of her quizzes are extra credit you can take as many times as you need! She's very understanding of circumstance, too. As good a GEOG prof. as my man Logan!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT
